page.layout: One column of running text, with the page number at the head. No margin notes, no running head. The catchword "Actio-" stands alone at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: tiam dixissent. Ante Romanum ergà[?] excommunicatum a Synodo, & ipsis Romanis Pontificibus sententiam proferunt absolutionis: excommunicatum eiectumque a Synodo plena nulla in re hæsitantes, in osculum amplectuntur; & salutem suam, & Dei placitum in depositi excommunicatique communione ponunt. Et atrociora investigamus? Et ridiculum plane est, profiteri fautores Photij, se ipsos uti viciniores, & rebus præsentes, melius res tenuisse. Romani nanque Pontifices Nicolaus, & Adrianus non inconsulto, ac temere, sed re antea diligentius pervestigata, testium, qui rebus interfuerunt, accurato examine, tum præ-missis ad Photium monitionibus, ut iniuste occupata restitueret, & eo obnitente, & restitutionem differente sententiam dixerunt. Et licet de Synodis Romanis in Photium idquoq; concederetur, quid ipsi dicerent de Synodo Generali Constantinopoli adversus ipsum Photium coacta? Eam etiam incompertas habuisse iuxta cum Romanis fraudes, & conatus Photij? Vides quam leviter Photiani isti in rebus serijs nugantur? Planum itaque est ante Epistolam Ioannis eosdem unitos fuisse Photio: nanque post lectam Ioannis Papæ ad Imperatores Epistolam idem Procopius subnectit eadem Actio-

page.notes: The first word "tiam" is a fragment of a word begun on the previous page. "ergà" is uncertain (accent-like mark over the a); marked [?]. The printed hyphen in "præ-missis" is a line-end hyphen. Orthography kept as printed (idquoq;, Photij, Ioannis, Epistolam); u/v and i/j normalised per the rules. No printing errors were corrected.
